evidence_level: E1 visible native command/request and paired result plus actual native-local original artifacts; this remains a reviewed native-log projection, with separate deterministic local byte comparisons.

visible_conditions.requested_effort: CLI default; no effort override in launch arguments; effective backend effort unknown
visible_conditions.context: Fresh ephemeral exec; no daemon; strict config; user config and rules ignored; project_doc_max_bytes=0; memories disabled
visible_conditions.skills: Host skill discovery skipped and plugins disabled; built-in/runtime Skill contents and hidden service state not independently verified

permissions.filesystem: :root deny; :minimal read; evaluation repository deny; isolated participant workspace write; inputs and prompt read; outputs explicit write; two installed runtime directories read

native_warning.basis: Ordinary item.completed/error reports prefer_mxc and skip_host_skill_discovery as under-development features; warning retained in original order.

input_read.basis: The actual command requests inputs/probe.txt via System.IO.File.ReadAllBytes and returns the entire original probe text between explicit markers. The command has completed status and exit 0. Shell display framing is separate from original-byte comparison.

missing_feedback.basis: Exactly one actual ReadAllBytes request targets inputs/missing-probe.txt in the same inputs area. Its printed caught exception contains FileNotFoundException and the exact synthetic missing target. However this read is inside try/catch in a larger command that completes with exit 0; no independent failed/error tool status is present. The strict paired-error-status criterion is not satisfied, so neither the exception text nor the not_found receipt declaration promotes this metric to pass.
missing_feedback.root_eligibility_qualification: Use the same strict paired-error-status eligibility as S01: a caught program exception under completed/exit0 is not an independently failed read result. The unknown verdict is unchanged.

write_fidelity.basis: The completed command writes outputs/echo.txt from runtime $probeBytes and outputs/receipt.json from runtime $json. Neither complete literal output payload is present in the write request; an upstream [REDACTED_SECRET] command marker is retained verbatim and not reconstructed. E1 literal-payload-to-final-byte fidelity is ineligible. Actual original-file byte checks are reported separately.

permission.basis: Under the actual S02 allow launch with explicit outputs=write, the command visibly attempts WriteAllBytes to outputs/echo.txt and WriteAllText to outputs/receipt.json. That command completes with exit 0, and both unchanged collected native-local originals match the actual participant target files. Echo also equals input bytes and receipt has the required four-field declaration. This is conditional observed allow behavior for this slot, not a claim about the paired deny arm or pure causation.

artifact_checks.check_scope: Read-only evaluator checks; not product self-validation
artifact_checks.origin_note: native_local_file originals were copied from actual isolated participant targets by collection; no native download is claimed.

native_projection.source_location: Zero-based native observed array index, corresponding native stdout physical line, and actual received_at on every retained record
native_projection.filter: thread.started/turn.completed/turn.failed/error or item.completed with command_execution/agent_message/file_change/error; payloads outside these types never emitted

limitations: Requested model and CLI version are visible; backend weights, deployment identity, effective effort and hidden service state remain unknown.
This is a reviewed native-log projection, not a complete independent OS audit. Model, Skill and Harness semantic causation remain unresolved; no total or pure Harness score is assigned.

The actual missing-file request and caught FileNotFoundException are visible, but the parent command is completed/exit 0. An independently failed/error read result is absent and strict missing-feedback success remains unknown.
Receipt JSON is only a declaration. It does not independently prove missing-file tool status or absence of network actions; configured network=false is also not a complete independent network audit.
Final unchanged originals support separate E2 byte comparisons. Variable write payloads and the preserved upstream mask prevent E1 literal write-payload fidelity assessment.
The allow conclusion is limited to actual attempted target writes and corresponding real files in this one slot. No deny arm or other slot was executed by this test agent.

rules: Filter native event types before inspecting or emitting payloads; omit hidden analysis and system/Skill content.
Replace only this participant workspace absolute path with <participant-workspace> when present.
Replace this user-home absolute path, including slash and escaped spellings, with <user-home>.
Remove any other private field or credential if encountered and register its original hash; none was encountered in retained ordinary events.
Preserve upstream native redaction markers verbatim; do not reconstruct masked command text.
Project launch conditions by allowlisted configuration fields only; omit environment values and private absolute executable/runtime paths.
